estructuras.nombre: contradicción: la empresa que nunca vende, en pérdida y expulsada

frases.texto: (gancho)
If you own an index fund, you may own a piece of it.
It paid about seventy-five thousand dollars per bitcoin.
This week, bitcoin fell near sixty-four thousand.
The company built to never sell is underwater.
Now MSCI is dropping it from its indexes.
Funds that copy those indexes must sell the stock.
Strategy doesn't have to sell a single bitcoin.
But raising cash to buy more just got harder.
Nobody knows where bitcoin goes next. This is not advice.
That vault holds about one of every twenty-five bitcoin that will ever exist.

estructuras.nombre: cuenta atrás: dieciséis días hasta la expulsión

frases.texto: (gancho)
In sixteen days, your index fund may sell it.
It paid about seventy-five thousand per coin.
Bitcoin just fell near sixty-four thousand.
The whole stack is worth less than it paid.
At the end of November, MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes.
Funds that copy MSCI must sell the shares.
Strategy is not forced to sell its bitcoin.
But its machine for buying more runs on selling stock.
Nobody knows where bitcoin goes next. This is not advice.
When the clock runs out, the vault is either still full or for sale.

ganchos.texto: Strategy went from software company to bitcoin vault and now loses money on its bitcoin.
Strategy, the company that promised to never sell bitcoin, is getting kicked out of the index.

contradiccion.nota: Una idea: la empresa que nunca vende está en pérdida y la echan del índice. 'you may own a piece of it' abre el bucle; se cierra con la expulsión y la cifra final del vault. A mitad pasa algo (MSCI entra), no se explica una estadística.

cuenta_atras.nota: Cuenta atrás concreta, pero 'sixteen' suma una 4.ª cifra y el cierre es dicotomía forzada.

contradiccion+g1.nota: Gancho con nombre poco conocido + aposición y la contradicción dentro (vault que pierde). La mitad avanza la historia (MSCI la expulsa). Cierre dato compartible: uno de cada 25 bitcoin.

contradiccion+g2.nota: Adelanta la expulsión en el gancho: gasta el giro de mitad.
